description: arXiv:2608.14947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting opioid craving from wearable physiological signals is critical yet difficult, with the potential to support proactive interventions for individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD). This challenge is especially pronounced under subject-independent evaluation because craving is subjective, heterogeneous, and often physiologically entangled...
